note: g_repair_held (#192, T-466) — a repair is not done until it survives a real scraper cycle: scripts/assert-repair-held.mjs <invariant> --cycles N records the violation count (must be 0), records a cycle marker (max(last_scraped_at/updated_at) over ipos + latest scraper_logs cycle id), polls until N distinct real cycles have passed, and re-runs the invariant after each. Wired into defect-fix-contract.md item 5 and docs/ops/prod-ops-recipes.md section 8 as the mandatory last step of every data-repair fix task.
